items.text: Imam Sadegh University stated that Mehdi Naderi Jahromi did not study at the university. Iran International's report mentioned a person named 'Kia' as a graduate of Imam Sadegh University. This person was introduced as a Mossad spy.

The Italian national football team defeated Turkey 3-1 in the fourth week of the UEFA Nations League. Italy's goals were scored by Gianluca Scamacca, Calafiori, and Esposito. Turkey scored one goal by Şimşir.

Farzin Nadimi stated that the Yemeni government's operation against areas controlled by the Houthis has begun with Saudi support. Government forces are trying to increase pressure on Sanaa and coastal areas near Bab al-Mandab. Weakening the Houthis could increase Saudi and US focus on maritime security and developments in the Strait of Hormuz.

Ali Sadrazadeh said the advance of Yemen's government forces with Saudi support shows that airstrikes alone are not enough and ground operations play a key role. Control of Bab al-Mandab and Taiz is strategically important for Saudi Arabia. Pakistan and Turkey are likely to provide military and logistical aid to Saudi Arabia, but direct involvement in the Yemen war is unlikely.

A group of Iranians gathered on Tuesday, 14 Mehr, in front of the UK Prime Minister's office. They protested against the execution of their compatriots by the Islamic Republic. The gathering was in support of those sentenced to death in Iran.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the governor of the Central Bank, said that the American officials' promise of the collapse of Iran's economy will not come true. He understands the economic pressures on the people and the government is trying to reduce problems during the economic war.

A number of Farda Motors customers gathered on Tuesday, October 6, in front of the judiciary in Semnan province. They protested the judicial process of the company's case. They also criticized the imposition of an unfair agreement.

Workers of North Drilling Company reported delays in payment of their wages and claims. Workers of Mohammadan CNG station have not been paid for five months, and workers of Maroon Oil and Gas Industrial Complex No. 6 are facing three months of unpaid wages and non-payment of insurance premiums.

The Spanish football team defeated Croatia 2-1 in their fourth match in the UEFA Nations League. Mikel Merino scored both goals for Spain, while Ivan Perisic scored for Croatia. This victory brought Spain's total points to 12.

Omid Memarian reported the arrest of another suspect in the suspicious activities around the Fairford base. He examined the possibility of the detainees' connection to a foreign government. If the role of the Islamic Republic is proven, the national security of Britain and Europe will be directly involved.
